name: LoveCraft
source: A man wakes up in the middle of a forest with no memories of his own past. What could've happened to him? Who was him, really? Follow this unknown character through his journey trying to remember his past.
translation: 一名男子在森林中醒来，对自己的过去失去了记忆。他可能发生了什么事情？他到底是谁？跟随这个未知的角色走过他的旅程，试图记住他的过去。
